name: ShoulderCupid
shortDescription: Hackathon Winner — Cupid lost his bow, so he whispers the secrets of love directly in your ear. A wearable AI matchmaker.
description: ShoulderCupid is a hackathon-winning wearable that puts a tiny 'shoulder cupid' on your shoulder, listening to the conversation and whispering AI-driven love advice in your ear in real time.
